title: World virtual turns
kicker: World and empire · End Turn clock
hook: **Virtual turns** are the world clock — everyone commits orders, then **End Turn** resolves them for every commander at once.

blindSpots.meaning: A shared resolve step on the map. Not a live match timer and not a real-life diary day.
The button (or control) that commits the turn. The barrier waits until you and the other commanders are ready.
What you set for legions before the turn resolves — march, claim, and later richer tools.
A minute→day→week meta calendar. This game does not use one for the world — only lawn time, expedition wall-clock, and virtual turns.

alsoTrue: Expeditions use wall-clock because they are idle. The map does not — it waits on End Turn.
Same clock applies when the finished [world stage](world-stage) arrives.

sections.title: What it is
paras: Time on the map is turn-based. There is no clock bullying you while you think.
When orders are set, press End Turn. You, Zomboss, and neutrals resolve together.

sections.title: How it works

cards.name: Set
cards.body: Issue orders for your legions while the turn is open.

cards.name: Commit
cards.body: Press End Turn when you are ready.

cards.name: Resolve
cards.body: Everyone’s orders fire — including Zomboss evaluating from his fog.

diagram: set orders  ->  End Turn  ->  resolve for all commanders

groups.title: On the World map
groups.intro: Open World travel and look for End Turn once you can issue orders.
steps: Set at least one legion order.
Read what moved — yours and theirs.
groups.note: If nothing resolves, you have not committed the turn yet.

doSteps: Give one clear order (march or claim).
Press End Turn and watch the resolve — including enemy motion.
doNote: Stop when End Turn ≠ “wait five real minutes.” Related: [world map](world-map), [Zomboss](zomboss-commander).

mixUps.q: Does the map tick while I am AFK?
mixUps.a: No. It waits for End Turn. Expeditions are the wall-clock loop.

mixUps.q: Is this the same as lawn time?
mixUps.a: No. Lawn is a live match. The map is virtual turns.

mixUps.q: Do I need to End Turn for expeditions?
mixUps.a: No. Expeditions use their own dispatch timers.

mixUps.q: Does Zomboss move on my End Turn?
mixUps.a: Yes. Everyone resolves together when you commit.
